# Integrated Math

> Student-run, free online mathematics competitions and learning resources.

Official website: https://www.integratedmath.org
Contact: info@integratedmath.org

## Public information
- [Competitions](https://www.integratedmath.org/competitions): Dates, formats, and tournament archive.
- [Fall 2026 archive](https://www.integratedmath.org/competitions/fall-2026): Overall and round placements, honorable mentions, and registration figures of 440+ competitors from 57+ countries; problem and solution files are pending.
- [Fall 2026 rules](https://www.integratedmath.org/competitions/fall-2026/rules): Published event rules and format.
- [Spring 2026](https://www.integratedmath.org/competitions/spring-2026): Results, problems, and solutions.
- [Learning resources](https://www.integratedmath.org/learn): Diagnostic information and resource archive.
- [Team and contact](https://www.integratedmath.org/team): Organizers and contact form.
- [Sponsors](https://www.integratedmath.org/sponsors): Current sponsors.
- [Privacy](https://www.integratedmath.org/privacy): Information practices.
- [Terms](https://www.integratedmath.org/terms): Use of resources and services.
- [Cookies](https://www.integratedmath.org/cookies): Account and diagnostic storage.

Contest attempts, administrator pages, diagnostic results, and API endpoints contain private or operational data and are not public reference materials. Follow the event rules and the reuse notices supplied with individual resources.
